# f5xc_authorization_server (Resource)

Authorization Server Configuration

To get more information about f5xc_authorization_server, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/authorization-server)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Authorization Server - Full

resource "f5xc_authorization_server" "example" {
  name        = "example-authorization-server"
  namespace   = "default"
  description = "Full authorization server example"
  jwks_uri    = "https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/certs"

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "platform-team"
  }
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell

```
